# `double-release`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: correctness · Profile: none · Default: warning · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports more than one visible release of the same allocation in one control-flow
scope.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Releasing storage twice can corrupt allocator state or trigger safety checks.

## When it fires

It targets duplicate `free` or `destroy` operations whose binding identity is
unambiguous.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn make(gpa: std.mem.Allocator) !void {
    const buf = try gpa.alloc(u8, 8);
    gpa.free(buf);
    gpa.free(buf);
}
```
